I was hunting for something to help me at home with my rosacea, acne, and broken capillaries/spider veins on my face. After using this for over a year, I can say it has done wonders for my skin. The blue light really gets rid of purple and red veins in my skin, with regular daily use, I see results within 1-2 weeks. I have literally completely gotten rid of entire veins in my nose and cheeks with this! The facial cleaning brush is nice, too. My first one did break after owning for 11 months, does not seem as water proof as it could be. But thankfully they have a great warranty, and I was easily able to get a replacement.
I only use this a handful of times. It says it's waterproof, but it's not. I got water in it and it's not covered by the warranty. Don't buy this. It's junk.

I am a 39 year old woman. I won the genetic lottery and inherited my mom's hormonal acne. Anyone who suffers from adult acne knows that it does not occur because you're not cleansing well or don't eat right. In fact, over cleansing and restrictive diets can actually make it worse. I see my dermatologist regularly and have taken multiple medications in my life to reduce certain hormones to prevent cystic acne. While these medications have helped tremendously, it is not good for your kidneys/liver to be on these indefinitely. I purchased this PMD Acne cleansing tool after much research. Within ONE use I noticed a difference! I had three cystic, under-the-skin pimples coming in and after using this morning and night (so just two times), two of the pimples shrunk considerably and the largest one went away of three more days. I have not had one single pimple since incorporating this into my morning and night routine. I've been using it only two weeks now. I'm soooo happy! My skin feels so smooth and I am not getting painful and embarrassing acne. I have caught two or three small pimples starting to develop and stopped them from forming and shrunk them after one day of use which for me is using it morning and night and applying the blue light which is fantastic! I like to pair this with my favorite La Roche Posay face washes. This will change your life!!! My skin has never looked so good and it's just getting better! It's gentle and unlike getting a facial which often includes extr

I woke up and my face was red, almost looked burnt where i had used it on my face. Super itchy too.. Another side note, it didn't get the sides of my nose clean. That ended up being a good thing with the new found allergy. Not for me.
I was so excited about this product but when I turned it on for the first time the blue light blinked and then died. I had to return it.

I am so impressed with this device, it has made HUGE changes to my skin after just about a week of use. It was a score at half price on Ulta's beauty deal days but it is worth the full price too. A must have for me now!

avis.titre: Perfect brush for acne prone skin
avis.texte: This facial cleansing brush is so versatile, and it actually does its job. It has two vibration settings that provide a deep, thorough cleansing. It works well with both oil and water-based cleansers, but water-based cleansers lather and foam better. You have to be cautious and make sure you aren't spending too much time in one area, as it can cause redness and irritation like any other skin care tool. You can then follow-up with blue-light therapy for acne. It vibrates to signal the beginning of a 3-minute spot treatment which was incredibly helpful when treating multiple areas. The entire brush is silicone, meaning it's easy to clean, antimicrobial, and waterproof. It comes with little goggles so you don't burn your corneas away if treating near the eyes. It's rechargeable and comes with its own carrying case for easy travel. I personally love this cleansing brush and it's one of the best brushes I have used yet. It really does get in the pores and clean the skin.

If you're considering this brush, take this as your sign to try it! I love the scrubbing end; as well as the blue light side. I feel it really helped my acne and helped clear my skin. It wasn't too rough, and it was extremely easy to use and I recommend it

The vibration function helps to clean the skin, and remove dirt, oil, and impurities. The blue light technology then helps to kill acne-causing bacteria and reduce any inflammation. After using the PMD Clean Acne Smart Facial Cleansing device, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin. My acne breakouts were reduced, and my skin looked clearer and is glowing. Overall, I highly recommend the PMD Clean Acne Smart Facial Cleansing device with blue light technology. It not only effectively cleanses the skin but also helps to fight acne and improve overall skin health. With its gentle yet powerful performance, this device is a must-have for anyone looking to achieve clearer, healthier, and more radiant skin.

I really enjoy using this tool in my nightly double cleanse routine, and have noticed gentle exfoliation after each use. I seriously couldn't believe how baby-soft my textured skin was after just one use. The ergonomic design of the PMD Clean Acne Tool ensures comfortable handling and ease of use. The compact size and lightweight construction make it travel-friendly, enabling users to maintain their skincare routine on the go. The intuitive button controls and LED indicator lights provide straightforward operation, even for individuals new to skincare devices. In terms of performance, I observed significant improvements in my skin's condition after incorporating the PMD Clean Acne Tool into my regimen. Regular use resulted in reduced inflammation, minimized breakouts, and a clearer complexion overall. I appreciated the gentle yet effective approach of the tool, which prevented irritation and sensitivity commonly associated with harsh acne treatments.

I love the tools from PMD! I am a licensed cosmetologist with 18+ years of experience working in various areas of the skin and cosmetology industry! I've worked specifically in skin care for many years. I have combination skin that leans a bit oily, is sensitive, and acne prone. I also have mild rosacea on my cheeks. It is such a nice treat to do my self care at the end of the day and really see results.

This acne cleansing device it an amazing and smart product. It has 2 sides, one side is the hygienic silicone made cleanser with 2 vibration modes. The other side is blue light for acne. It treats mild to moderate acne. Amazing invention.
Amazing cleaning device! It really gets all of the diet abs oils off of tie skin and cleanses very well!

As an oily and breakout prone person, it can be really difficult to handle certain breakouts. When I used to get facials, I would often ask for additional light therapy to help with stubborn breakouts. This wand is literally an at home facial. With consistent use, I noticed my pores a lot less congested from excess oil and my breakouts healed a lot faster. it's also very easy to use because it fits well in the hand. The silicone brush head is great for areas that experience more pore clogging like the t zone. Such a great tool to have and also a phenomenal gift as well!

You do not have to be a cosmetologist or aesthetician to appreciate a comforting cleanse and a nice massage! Now put the two together and you have PMD's Clean Acne Device. Nearly ten years in the beauty industry and I have never been MASSAGED AND CLEANSED at the same time. I've been cleansed and polished simultaneously, but the two vibration settings on PMD's device alone has earned them 5 stars already. Once I got past the massaging silicone bristles (which feel sooooo divine *drools*), the other side has blue light to counteract breakouts! And it certainly helped me zap my zits! I've been dealing with hormonal issues which led to a horrendous and painful flare-up that I just didn't have the energy to deal with. PMD made it easy! After spoiling myself with a massage, I simply turn my device over, press the button, and begin treating my skin with blue light. And guess what? That side vibrates too! Initially, I was concerned about water leaking into the casing of the blue lights, but upon further examination, I don't think that will be a problem anytime soon. This device makes good on every promise. It's rechargeable, comes with eye protection when using the blue light side, and it includes a warranty. I recommend this device to anyone looking to easily manage acne of all forms and/or facial tension.

The PMD Clean Acne is great for a deep cleansing and healing and preventing future breakouts. I have been a Licensed Cosmetologist for over 17 years and skincare is one of my specialties. I have suffered with hormonal acne since I was in my teens. I was excited to learn about this tool because I have limited storage space in my bathroom and this is two neat products in one. I would highly recommend this for anyone suffering with acne.

avis.titre: Great for cleansing and treating acne prone skin
avis.texte: I am a licensed esthetician and I am always looking for different products and tools to help treat all skin conditions, especially acne. The PMD Clean Acne is an amazing tool in my opinion. I did feel the the cleansing sign should probably only be used on the lower setting, in my personal opinion anything higher may be irritating if you already have acne/inflammation. I absolutely love the blue light therapy spot treatment, I am a big fan of light therapy in general, and I think that this is an amazing product to have for at home use and spot treatment. The light feels comforting and warm and lets you know when it is time to take off and remove to a different treatment area. It's effortless and truly works. If you're having issues with acne and breakouts I highly recommend this cleanser/LED light to help you with your clearing journey.

avis.titre: Clean Acne - Blue Light Therapy Spot Treatment
avis.texte: As a licensed cosmetologist I have tried many cleansing brushes. PMD Clean Acne has taken cleansing brushes to the next level. They created a two in one brush that offers blue light therapy and cleaning in one. Charging was super easy to do. The blue light feature has a timer which I loved. I have been using this on acne spots non stop. I hope to see results. The cleansing brush is easy to use. I did see some broken capillaries when using it the first time but was able to use it a few more times without this happening. So go gentle if you start using it to wash your face. I have sensitive skin, rosacea and acne prone as mid thirty year old for reference. PMD Clean Acne has stayed charged for me since using it for the past month. The charger and case are super handy to store.

This is the first device I have used from this brand, but as a clinical esthetician I have had my eye on it for awhile. I appreciate the different options that this offers. The cleansing mode definitely gets a deeper clean experience than cleanser alone. I do have sensitive skin, along with acne-prone, and would recommend starting more gently and working up to using daily for sensitive skin like mine. This is great for a boost to your cleansing routine, and will increase exfoliation to get a deeper clean, tho it may not be necessary to use this every day. Also, I used a gentle cream cleanser to start directly on the device before I realized it was recommended to apply on face before using wet device - it makes it more difficult to get cleanser out of the device otherwise. I do really love the blue light feature and it did really seem to help calm my skin.

PMD Clean Acne is AMAZING!!!! I honestly can't say enough about this tool. It's a must and everyone needs one. I used to use the Clarisonic cleansing device and spent so much money on the refill heads. This PMD tool is not only silicone which makes it easier to clean and not prone to bacteria, but you don't have to purchase refill heads. This all in one tool cleanses your face, it has different settings, depending on the type of cleaning you want. It removes all traces of makeup, and leaves skin super soft and clean. The battery life is incredible as well. You can charge once and it can last you for a long time. More than 2 weeks. I use my tool morning and night. For abut 5 minutes each. So 10 minutes total each day. One side is your cleansing side and the other is the blue light side. I started breaking out on my chin and after 4 days I noticed it had gone done tremendously. Meaning breakouts were slowly fading away and getting healed. This tool not only is it safe even for the most sensitive complexions but it's helps with acne. It won't fix your acne in 1 day, but if you use it consistently, you will see results in as little as 3 days. This brand has turned me into a long term and loyal customer!

In my eight years as an esthetician, I have experienced a wide range of brushes designed for cleansing and treating acne. Most other brands designs harbor bacteria, causing more issues than before! The blue light therapy is highly effective at reducing my ingrown hairs that tend to cause scarring. I'm obsessed with this tool! All PMD products are amazing but this one is something special. I love that this product is an actual scrubber for cleansing and the back is a blue light. avis.titre: Cleansing acne brush and led therapy

avis.titre: Amazing gentle skin clearing and cleaning device!
avis.texte: This is definitely a one of a kind skin clearing and cleaning device and I'm loving using it and the results I'm getting from it. I tend to get light acne in my chin and blackheads on my nose and I've noticed they've come and gone way faster than normal since using this device. I love the silicone feel instead of a brush so it feels more gentle and also I know there's no bacteria being left inside of it like brush cleaning devices. The blue light feature is extra cool if you have a breakout it definitely helps get rid of it quicker. I used a natural cleanser at first but it didn't suds up or get that good of a clean, so make sure to use a cleanser that suds nicely or you might have to apply extra product to ensure a thorough clean. It's awesome it has a self timer on the light and the vibrating effect is soothing and you really feel like you get the job done. Highly recommend this product.

I have had my eye on this for awhile and was so happy to see how well the blue light technology actually works. The silicone bristle side is great. It has two different speeds. You can feel it cleansing your face and getting your pores clean! The Blue Light side has a separate button that you use and once its touching your face then it lights up! I really enjoy that aspect of the tool. I don't have to worry about getting blinded before applying it to my skin! I LOVE the fact that it vibrates once to let you know that it's started then vibrates three times to let you know when its done! I hate having to set alarms on my phone for my skincare so this is an added bonus! I can honestly say I have seen a huge difference in the size of my pores and less acne since using this. I highly reccomend this for anyone having issues with clogged pores and acne!

I have been eager for a new blue light device for a while. This is a great way to introduce oneself to blue light therapy before investing in a pricer alternative. It instantly reduces inflammation juristically.

avis.titre: Clearing skin one day at a time!
avis.texte: As a licensed esthetician for four years now, i have tried many beauty products/tools to recommend to family, friends, and clients. This is my first time trying the PMD Clean Acne facial cleansing device. To start off this device is very very well made! The packaging is beautiful and i love that the cleansing brush is silicone with an LED light on one side. The brush itself has two different modes for cleansing. One is more of an intense vibration than the other. After i cleanse and dry my skin, i like to use the LED light for 3 minutes as directed. I have noticed an amazing difference in my acne. My skin has looked more radiant and definitely feels very squeaky clean! Overall, I highly recommend the PMD Clean Acne. You will definitely be in love with it!

I've taken on a new leadership position with my job and it's causing lots of stress breakouts. I have all of the cleansers, oils and serums to help heal the acne that's on the surface but I needed something that can get underneath. The PMD Clean Acne device is great for deep cleaning daily without being too aggressive on the skin. I can use one side for cleaning and the other for blue light therapy. The cleansing side allows me to spend more time on my problem areas without causing irritation or discomfort. The other side allows you to use blue light therapy for a three minute spot treatment for acne and can be repeated as needed to mild acne. I wouldn't suggest this as a treatment for cystic acne as it doesn't get that deep under the skin. I give this a 5/5

I've been wanting to try blue light therapy for some time now. With my oily combination skin, I frequently have a blemish here and there as well as some blackheads in the t-zone area that I consistently have to work at maintaining. The PMD Clean Acne device with blue light therapy really helped clean up my complexion without having to use an added specialized product like a mask for blemish solution. I had a small blemish between my eyebrows and after using it just twice in row nightly, the blemish significantly reduced in size and by the third night it was gone. The cleansing side of the device is a nice silicone brush with vibration which is super for everyday use morning and night. The only thing I would change is its shape because it felt like I couldn't get a real good cleansing around my nose which is my oily zone. I've been in the beauty industry for 30+ years. Within that time, I've worked for a handful of cosmetic/skincare brands. In addition, I worked as a cosmetologist for 7+ years, makeup and lash artist as well. I have mature, oily/combination skin tone.

My blackhead has also became less noticeable. It is easy and gentle to use. The PMD Clean acne is perfect for those with acne prone skin.

I don't think washing my face has ever felt so good or gotten so clean.
